body:
DMT, Trazadone, Melatonin, Sierra Nevada Pale Ale, Tylenol
First off, I know Im an idiot for the combo. Ive been using psychedelics for 33 years and have no idea how I got to this combo of stupidity justified in my head last night.
I started with 4 Tylenol Arthritis or 2,600mg and a beer with dinner at around 7pm. Ive never had issues in the past with mixing Tylenol, low dose alcohol, and vaping DMT. Then around 9:30 I took  1,300 more of Tylenol and sleep meds of 100mg of Trazadone and 30mg of Melatonin.
I NEVER in 33 years have taken a drug like Trazadone within 5 days of vaping DMT or use of any psychedelic substance. If my sleep is off, Ill take Trazadone and Melatonin, but I ALWAYS in the past gave myself the higher end of half life estimates and waited to use psychedelics until Trazadone was totally out of my system.
I ALWAYS in the past gave myself the higher end of half life estimates and waited to use psychedelics until Trazadone was totally out of my system.
This wasnt the case last night. I think it was just that Trazadone stupor I get if I dont take it everyday that led me to grab my vape pen with DMT. I make my own carts and always have. 1:1 ratio. I do however do my carts at 650mg of DMT to .65ml of straight PG and fills them to the brim. Im precise. I live and die to study psychedelics.
So I took my normal full 10sec rip off my pen plus a little extra and had a very non visual trip. To be expected I thought with Trazadone. No big deal. Or so I thought. About an hour after DMT was done I went to make a fruit smoothie and apparently blacked out. I woke up tangled in my bike that is in my room. Nearly sent my bike into my guitar, but instead took out my router thank God. But I have no memory today. Gone? My head is very full feeling today like a cross between a cold and tail end of nitrous high. Im functional today, but way way off. Daffy almost?
Long story short, no go Id say on Trazadone and psychedelics.
